hooks.command: jq -r 'if .stop_hook_active then empty else {decision: "block", reason: "Before ending this session: review for concrete saveable learnings — corrections received, non-obvious approaches the user validated, project facts you learned, or external references. If you find any, surface them to the user with brief proposed memory entries (name, type, one-line summary) and ask which to persist. Save project-specific learnings to the current project memory directory and cross-project learnings (user preferences, workflow feedback, general patterns) to ~/.claude/memory/. If nothing notable stands out, say \"nothing notable to save\" in one line and end — do not fish."} end' 2>/dev/null || true
